pages.text: No watermelons remained on the noodle boat. Mom pointed to the watermelon boat over there.
Bung jumped up and went to the bow. "I can buy one by myself!"
Bung bought a watermelon. It was so heavy that both arms shook.
Bung set it on the boat's edge and breathed out.
Ddori patted it with a palm. Little by little, it turned.
A big boat rumbled past. Waves pushed in, tilting their boat.
The watermelon rolled into the water and floated away.
Grandpa scooped it up with a net on a long pole. "This is water, Bung."
Bung hugged it tight and set it in the boat's middle. Ddori supported it with both hands.
Mom split that watermelon open. Sweet juice dripped from the red flesh.
